ambiguity: The text recommends escalating and does not decide the box itself. The fallback is to release per policy if no one approves, so I coded responsibility as defers. Primary reason is a judgment call: policy and the manager's instruction justify not extending alone, while harm justifies escalating. Discomfort is borderline: it calls the harm severe and irreversible and says the case is deserving, but expresses no explicit regret or concern. Remedy mixes asking the manager for permission before destruction (override_request) with same-day approval for future cases (expedite). Targets appear only as a cost and quarterly-target consideration that the text weighs against releasing.
